# ManhwaToNovel

> Latest manhwa and light-novel chapters in one place, with the community-sourced
> manhwa to novel chapter equivalence: when you finish the manhwa, find exactly
> which novel chapter to continue from, and where to read each source. The site
> indexes where to read each work and its latest chapter per source; it does not
> host the chapters. Spanish-first (manhwatonovel.com), English under /en/.

## Main sections
- [Catalog](https://www.manhwatonovel.com/novelas): every work, manhwa and light novels, with alternative titles.
- [Rankings](https://www.manhwatonovel.com/rankings): where the most story remains undrawn (novel far ahead of the manhwa).
- [New chapters](https://www.manhwatonovel.com/novedades): updated nightly. RSS feed: https://www.manhwatonovel.com/rss.xml
- [Browse by title](https://www.manhwatonovel.com/titulos/a): find a work by its other names (English, Korean, romanized).

## What is unique here
- Per-work manhwa to novel chapter equivalence (e.g. /novela/<slug>/equivalencia): the gap between the latest manhwa chapter and how far the novel goes, so a reader knows which novel chapter to continue from.
- Works that exist as both manhwa and novel are the priority of the catalog; single-format works are also indexed.
